_comment: Gold labels for the deterministic (JSON-LD) extraction path. Each case names a fixture and the recipe a human would expect the app to save. Add a case by dropping an HTML fixture next to this file and appending an entry.

cases.note: Yoast @graph + attributes on the ld+json script tag

expected.name: One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Toss the chicken with oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Arrange in a single layer with the lemon slices tucked around.
Roast for 35 minutes until the skin is crisp and juices run clear.

cases.note: WP Recipe Maker sectioned steps must flatten in order

expected.name: Chana Salad
steps: Combine everything in a large bowl.
Dress with lemon juice, cumin, salt.

cases.note: Bare Recipe node, instructions as plain strings

expected.name: Tofu Stir Fry
steps: Sear the tofu in sesame oil until golden on all sides.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and pepper, stir fry 4 minutes.
Splash in soy sauce and toss to coat.

cases.note: Broken first ld+json block must not abort the scan

expected.name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients, add the wet, rest 10 minutes, then cook on a hot buttered griddle until bubbles form and the edges set.

expectedMisses.why: No structured data — must return null so the caller falls through to the LLM tail rather than saving a wrong recipe.
